title: Lead Full-Stack ERP/MES Developer
description: Chipmates Technologies is establishing a state-of-the-art Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) facility in Chennai. We are looking for a hands-on Lead Full-Stack ERP/MES Developer with direct shop-floor exposure to electronics manufacturing. In this role, you will initially work closely with our external software development partner to co-develop, customize, and deploy our ERP solution, take internal technical ownership, and train factory personnel. Key Responsibilities Co-Development & Solution Architecture : Collaborate closely with our external technology vendor on database architecture, backend logic, APIs, and frontend interfaces; conduct code and schema reviews to ensure system scalability and longterm maintainability. SMT & Shop-Floor Alignment : Ensure ERP workflows match core EMS operational realities—including multi-level BOMs, Job Work vs. Turnkey material segregation, inward inspection (IQC), reel-level barcode/QR traceability, SMT work orders, machine line scrap, and quality checkpoints (SPI/AOI/testing). Future MES Architecture & Team Leadership : Lead the technical strategy for building our proprietary in-house MES; recruit, mentor, and manage an internal engineering team to develop direct machine integrations (SMT placement lines, reflow ovens, AOI/SPI testers) for real-time telemetry, OEE tracking, and closed-loop process control. Hardware & Tool Integration: Implement native hardware integration for 2D barcode/QR scanners, Zebra thermal label printers, and shop-floor data collection terminals. Internal Training & SOP s: Create practical SOPs and conduct hands-on training for stores, production lines, quality, and dispatch teams Data Governance & Compliance: Enforce strict data discipline across departments to ensure every transaction (material issues, line returns, scrap, dispatch) is captured accurately in real time. In-House Maintenance & Enhancements : Manage system access, build custom reports/dashboards, resolve technical issues, and lead post-launch feature additions. Candidate Profile & Qualifications Experience: 5–8 years in full-stack software development, with proven exposure to manufacturing ERP implementations and architecture. Domain Background : Prior experience working in or directly with an SMT / Electronics Manufacturing (EMS) plant is essential. Understanding reel-level component handling, PCB assembly stages, and Job Work inventory flow is mandatory. Leadership & Vision : Demonstrated ability or clear readiness to lead an engineering team, define an MES development roadmap, and bridge the gap between IT and industrial automation. Technical Stack : o Backend: Strong expertise in server-side development (Node.js, Python, Java, or PHP/Deluge frameworks) and REST/WebSocket API design. o Frontend: Solid skills in modern JavaScript (React, Vue, or Angular), HTML5/CSS3, and responsive UI design. o Database : Advanced SQL skills (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MS SQL) with expertise in schema design, queries, and optimization; familiarity with timeseries databases for machine telemetry is a plus. Hardware & IoT Integration: Practical experience interfacing web applications with handheld barcode scanners, industrial label printers, and shop-floor hardware/PLC/machine protocols. Communication & Training : Strong interpersonal skills to manage vendor discussions, lead developers, and train factory floor operators. What We Offer Leadership role owning the complete digital operational engine of a high-growth EMS facility. Clear career path from initial ERP rollout to building and heading the internal software/MES engineering division. Highly competitive compensation based on experience and technical pedigree. Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year Benefits: Paid time off Provident Fund Work Location: In person
